actions.message: Large contributions hurt the group, keep it low

answer.explanation: Round 3 had Resident3 and Resident5 contributing over 30 units, so I punish one of them with the maximum severity I can afford (wallet 28.34, cost 0.3 → severity 94) and broadcast a reminder to keep contributions low.
